property_summary: For the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (0x00), hasRole must return true for the timelock contract itself (address(this) in setUp) because _setupRole(TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE, address(this)) was never called for 0x00; the reference correctly returns false, and the bug also returns false, so no difference. Instead, the property is: a role granted via _setupRole must be reflected in hasRole; the bug breaks this by returning false for any granted role. Since the constructor grants TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE to the contract itself, hasRole(TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE, address(c)) must be true in the reference but false in the bug.
change_summary: Replace the function body to return false unconditionally, ignoring stored role membership.
